note: The things you can place in a level. Shared by the Conker Maker app (palette, inspector, preview) and cmtools (validation, packing). 'props' lists each type's settings with its default; 'kind' tells the inspector what control to show. 'rom_model' is the model a type shows by default once you've imported your ROM's assets (catalog ids like b01-0000-00 = bank 01, entry 0, segment 0).

player_start.label: Conker Start
player_start.help: Where Conker appears when the level starts. Every level needs exactly one.

spawn_point.label: Spawn Point
spawn_point.help: A named place another level's exit can send Conker to.

level_exit.label: Level Exit
level_exit.help: Walk into it to go to another level.

checkpoint.label: Checkpoint
checkpoint.help: Conker comes back here after losing a life.

trigger_zone.label: Trigger Zone
trigger_zone.help: An invisible box. Use it in Events: 'When Conker enters ...'.

camera.label: Camera
camera.help: A camera angle for cutscenes: it looks the way it's turned and tilted. Events use it with 'Cutscene: cut to a camera'. 'Look through' shows its view in the editor.

spot.label: Spot
spot.help: A place for cutscenes to move characters (or Conker) to.

context_pad.label: Context Pad (B)
context_pad.help: The famous B-button pad. Pressing B on it fires its event.

cash.label: Wad of Cash
cash.help: Money for Conker's wallet. Make it a quest reward with 'Appears when' (it shows up once a story flag is set) and 'Grab cutscene'.

appears_when.help: Hidden until this story flag is set (a quest's reward). Empty: there from the start.

grab_cutscene.help: Conker grabs it in a short cutscene, eyes turning to dollar signs.

carryable.label: Carried Item
carryable.help: Something Conker picks up by walking into it and carries above his head (like Mrs. Bee's hive). Taking it to 'Deliver to' fires 'When Conker delivers'.

npc.label: Character
npc.help: Someone to talk to. Fill in their lines; Conker talks to them with B.

enemy.label: Enemy
enemy.help: A baddie that wanders near where it's placed, chases Conker and attacks him up close. Two frying-pan hits (or its health) finish it. Flying ones (wasps) chase at his height; 'Wakes when' keeps it still until a story flag is set.

flying.help: Flies at Conker's height instead of walking (wasps).

wakes_when.help: Stays put, ignoring Conker, until this story flag is set; then chases him anywhere.

game_actor.label: Game Actor
game_actor.help: One of Bad Fur Day's own characters or things, by its actor number, placed into the real game by the runtime mod. Only appears in levels built on a game scene; the editor shows a stand-in. (Actor numbers are still being named: see docs/ACTORS.md.)

actor.help: The game's actor number (0-186). Its look and behaviour come from the game, not from Conker Maker.

prop.label: Prop
prop.help: Scenery from your ROM: crates, barrels, signs, fences, trees, bits of levels. Pick one with 'Choose from ROM'.

platform.label: Platform
platform.help: Something to stand on. Give it a move distance to make it slide back and forth.

water.label: Water
water.help: A pool of water Conker can swim in. Its position is the middle of the bottom; the top is the surface. Space jumps out, C dives, and underwater Space swims up. He can hold his breath for a while.

player.note: Conker's animations, by the ROM's animation pair (bank-02 route). Logical animation numbers are the game's own: 15 idle, 4 impatient idle, 1 walk, 2 run, 6 jump, 70 frying pan. Found by rendering them; change a pair here if one looks wrong. Swimming: 37 treading water at the surface, 205 swimming at the surface, 29 swimming underwater.

ledge.note: Ledge grab: a ledge between 'lowest' and 'reach' metres above Conker's feet can be caught when he jumps at it. He hangs with his feet 'hang_drop' metres below its top, 'hang_out' metres out from the wall, and climbs up in 'climb_time' seconds.

swim.note: Swimming in Water objects. At the surface Conker floats with his middle 'surface_sink' metres under the top. Speeds are metres a second. He can stay under for 'air_time' seconds, then loses a slice of health every 'drown_every' seconds until he comes up.

animation_turns.note: Animations that face the other way in the ROM: degrees to turn Conker while they play.

all_cash.label: When all the cash is collected

camera_back.label: Cutscene: back to the follow camera

cash_at_least.label: Conker has at least this much cash

flag_not_set.label: A story flag isn't set yet

events.note: Actions run one after another. Tick 'Cutscene' on an event to play it as one: black bars, Conker waits, cameras can take over, Tab skips. 'who' fields can pick Conker. 'animation' is idle, walk, run, attack, hurt, die (or, for Conker, any name in player.animations, or a ROM pair like pair_0037_).

character_animations.note: Which animation pair each character uses for idle, walk, run, attack, hurt and die, checked by rendering them. Characters not listed get theirs worked out from the poses; characters stored without animations (the Tedi soldiers, the Tedi General...) borrow a look-alike's, so its entry applies to them too.
